text: This report provides an update on the status of negotiations with Hydro One for the licensing of a portion of hydro right-of-way (ROW) for park use within the Emery Village Neighbourhood. Emery Village BIA has produced detailed design drawings of a proposed park on the hydro ROW that would pay tribute to the First Nations history in the area. The plans have been preliminarily reviewed by staff of Parks, Forestry and Recreation and Hydro One, as well as the local Councillor. Additional discussions with Transportation Services and City Planning are required to assess any conflict with a planned road identified in the Emery Village Transportation Master Plan as well as the Emery Village Secondary Plan, both of which are Council approved. If Council determines that a park is preferred for this site, then the Emery Village BIA will need to submit a formal application for the City to review…
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on February 21, 2018, and directed that interested persons be notified accordingly.
